intro: Turkmenistan is an authoritarian state with no real political opposition and tight control of information.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president holds almost all power; elections are not seen as free. Former president Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedov leads the People's Council and remains very influential.

chapters.title: Neutrality
text: In 1995 the UN recognised Turkmenistan's permanent neutrality. The internet and foreign media are heavily restricted.

keyTerms.meaning: A system where power is concentrated and freedoms are limited.
Not taking sides in other countries' conflicts.
